mapper.select: SELECT q.*, c.name as category_name, u.nickname as creator_name, t.id as tag_id, t.name as tag_name, t.color as tag_color FROM question q LEFT JOIN category c ON q.category_id = c.id LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON q.created_by = u.id LEFT JOIN question_tag qt ON q.id = qt.question_id LEFT JOIN tag t ON qt.tag_id = t.id WHERE q.id = #{id} AND q.deleted = 0
SELECT q.* FROM question q INNER JOIN question_tag qt ON q.id = qt.question_id WHERE qt.tag_id = #{tagId} AND q.deleted = 0 ORDER BY q.created_at DESC

SELECT * FROM question WHERE deleted = 0 AND status = 1 AND MATCH(title, content) AGAINST(#{keyword} IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE) ORDER BY MATCH(title, content) AGAINST(#{keyword} IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE) DESC LIMIT 50
mapper.update: UPDATE question SET view_count = view_count + 1 WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE question SET like_count = like_count + #{count} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE question SET collect_count = collect_count + #{count} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE question SET comment_count = comment_count + #{count} WHERE id = #{id}
